title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A man witnesses a few men threatening old people to vacate an old aged home. He decides to stand up to the goons and protect the building from being destroyed.

title: Ek Rajai Teen Lugai
desc: Krishna and Arti love each other and wish to marry. However, an astrologer's unusual prediction prompts Krishna to marry a terminally ill woman to alter his horoscope.

title: Rishton Ka Batwara
desc: Members in a family argue over property claims and take each other to court. However, this dispute drives a wedge in their relationships which affects future generations.

title: Aashik Aawara
desc: A desperate man, who works as an autorickshaw driver, goes on a quest to find his girlfriend and family in a big city despite facing many struggles.
